world.title: Arrival in the New World

tasks.name: Finish the opening tutorial, reach Astera and speak to the Handler

tips: Follow the red story markers; optional requests are not needed for this route.

world.title: Your first large monster
tips: Great Jagras follows the Kestodon encounter. Continue the story hunt instead of starting an optional quest.

tasks.name: Explore the Ancient Forest with the Handler and locate the Area 11 campsite

world.title: Reach the Wildspire Waste
tips: Stay with the research escort until the Barroth encounter begins.

world.title: The first Zorah operation
tips: Follow the siege objectives. Nergigante is not a slay requirement.

world.title: Open the Coral Highlands

tasks.name: Follow the Great Ravine expedition and meet the Third Fleet Master at the Research Base
Explore the Coral Highlands, encounter Tzitzi-Ya-Ku and find the campsite

tips: Sight Tzitzi-Ya-Ku for the expedition objective; an extra hunt is not required.

world.title: Enter the Rotten Vale

tasks.name: Take the Rotten Vale story expedition and discover Radobaan
Continue the expedition objective and sight Great Girros

tips: Great Girros only needs to be discovered here.

world.title: Reach the depths of the Vale

tasks.name: Follow the lower Rotten Vale story expedition until the Odogaron encounter
Into the Bowels of the Vale

world.title: Meet the First Wyverian

tasks.name: Find and speak to the First Wyverian during the Ancient Forest story expedition
A Fiery Throne Atop the Forest

tips: Rathalos and Diablos are both required; complete the two assignments in either order.

tasks.name: Follow the Wildspire Waste story expedition and investigate the unusual tracks

world.title: Investigate the unusual Rathian

tasks.name: Collect ??? Rathian evidence until the first research milestone and report to the Ecological Research team

tips: Pick up nearby ??? Rathian tracks during required travel to reduce repeat trips.

tasks.name: Finish the ??? Rathian research and report to the Chief Ecologist and Commander
Old World Monster in the New World

world.title: Track Nergigante

tasks.name: Follow the Admiral into the Elder's Recess and sight Dodogama, Uragaan and Lavasioth
Collect Nergigante evidence until the research objective is complete, then report in

tips: The expedition asks for sightings, not three extra hunts. Collect Nergigante tracks along the same route.

world.title: Resolve the three elder investigations

tasks.name: Complete the Ancient Forest elder-dragon investigation and report to the Field Team Leader
Complete the Wildspire Waste elder-dragon investigation and report to the Huntsman
Complete the Rotten Vale elder-dragon investigation and report to the Third Fleet Master

tips: All three elder assignments are required and may be completed in any order.
The research areas are Ancient Forest, Wildspire Waste and Rotten Vale; Kushala and Teostra are fought in the Elder's Recess.

world.title: Finish the World campaign

tasks.name: Complete the final story briefing and follow the Seeker to the Confluence of Fates

tips: World's campaign ends after Xeno'jiiva. HR 29/49 cap quests and title-update hunts are not required to start Iceborne.

iceborne.title: A new expedition

tasks.name: At HR 16 after World's ending, speak to the Feisty Fiver in Astera and follow the Ancient Forest Legiana investigation
Speak to the Commander, travel to Hoarfrost Reach and follow the Handler to Beotodus

tips: Iceborne must be installed. The World HR 29/49 cap quests are not prerequisites.

tasks.name: Take the Hoarfrost Reach story expedition and meet the Handler in Area 6
Explore Hoarfrost Reach with the Handler and Tracker, speak to the First Wyverian and follow the trail

iceborne.title: Investigate the new subspecies
tips: Both assignments are required; choose either order, then return to Seliana.

iceborne.title: Break through the blizzard
tips: Breaking Barioth's forelegs creates longer recovery openings.

iceborne.title: Follow Velkhana's trail

tasks.name: Follow the Ancient Forest story expedition and its Velkhana/Nargacuga encounters

tips: Nargacuga and Glavenus are both required. Gather Velkhana traces during these required hunts.

iceborne.title: Two more threats
tips: Tigrex and Brachydios are both required; complete them in either order.

iceborne.title: First confrontation with Velkhana

tasks.name: Finish any remaining Velkhana track research and attend the story briefing
A Tale of Ice and Fire

tips: This assignment repels Velkhana; the final slaying assignment comes later.

iceborne.title: Through the freezing mist

tasks.name: Follow the Hoarfrost Reach story expedition with the Handler until Shrieking Legiana appears

tips: Dung Pods can separate the two Legiana.

iceborne.title: The blade and the fangs
tips: Acidic Glavenus and Ebony Odogaron are both required; complete them in either order.

iceborne.title: Defend Seliana
tips: Follow the ballista and Dragonrazer objectives to finish the defense.

tasks.name: Follow the Elder's Recess story expedition to the Seething Bazelgeuse encounter

iceborne.title: The first elder-dragon mystery

tasks.name: Finish the first elder-dragon investigation by collecting evidence, then report to unlock the assignment

tips: Effluvia Resistance prevents effluvial maximum-health reduction.

tasks.name: Finish the second elder-dragon investigation and follow the Coral Highlands story encounter

iceborne.title: Set sail for Origin Isle

tasks.name: Speak to the Field Team Leader and depart for the Origin Isle story expedition

tips: Prepare and restock before departure; the next assignment follows this fight directly.

iceborne.title: Finish the Iceborne campaign
tips: Iceborne's campaign ends after Shara Ishvalda. Guiding Lands, MR cap quests and title-update assignments are outside this route.

expanded-equipment.json.materialNamesJoin: All material names resolve to the cached item catalogue.
expanded-equipment.json.skillNamesJoin: All granted skills and set bonuses resolve to the cached skill catalogue.
limits: Armour and charm crafting zenny is absent from the extracted CSVs and remains null; no rarity-based prices are invented.
Exact LR/HR requirements are not stated in the charm and Kinsect base tables and remain null; rarity 9+ records are Master Rank.
Five charms and Dragon Soul have no material recipe in this source; null paths are not displayed as forgeable.
The source decoration rarity-pool drop table contains incomplete/internal group values; it is not presented as an individual jewel probability.
Layered armour appearances are outside the combat armour source catalogue.

limitations: Palico armour forging-point costs are unavailable in the extracted set pages and remain null. Weapon forging points must not be copied onto armour.
Palico forging spends research points, not zenny.
Four Palico set-detail pages were not retrievable; retained catalogue coverage is audited separately below.
Post-update placeholder weapon translations were omitted rather than assigned misleading Acorn Spade stats or Iron Ore recipes.
Palico gear does not accept hunter decorations; its slot arrays are empty.

fauna-catalogue.json.note: Source-specific habitats, reward pools and base thresholds are retained. Unspecified time/weather and detailed spawn locations remain unknown; they are not inferred.

palico-supplement.json.armourResearchPointPrices: Unavailable in retrieved source; not inferred from weapon cost.
palico-supplement.json.postUpdateWeapons: Ghost α+, Frankie α+, Fatalis α+ remain omitted because Chronicles shows Acorn Spade placeholders.
palico-supplement.json.statusDisplayUnits: Kaiser Mace α Blast45 verified against Game8; source raw450 retained only in source archive.

correctedStatusDisplayUnits.note: Each named weapon has independently listed display values. Poison was already divided by10 by the original builder and is unchanged. Ordinary fire/water/thunder/ice/dragon values are not divided.

ordinaryElementConflict.name: Felyne Aloha Ukulele α+
ordinaryElementConflict.action: Retained original extracted value because sources disagree; no uniform element conversion applied.

atlas.mapGeometry: Original game images, no redrawn layouts or invented hotspots. Locale links are a separate list, not coordinates.
atlas.provenance: Cached source pages and inspected assets in research/base-map-data; world image dimensions match its original-file metadata. English base maps retain the original in-game cursor tooltip.
atlas.networkLimitations: Further direct image re-fetches returned HTTP 403. Previously cached original image bytes are retained unchanged.

limitations: The genuine armour part, charm, mantle, skill and empty socket exports were not retrievable from their public CDN during this build. The matching MHWorldData community vector recreations are used with explicit attribution instead.
Kinsect, Palico equipment, canteen and tool collection markers reuse genuine related inventory silhouettes. They are not claimed to be unique official portraits of every record.
Slot levels use their own empty socket shapes and visible level text; decoration level sprites use the genuine exported gem silhouettes.

prices.note: Only explicit crafting costs are imported. The source builder maps Cost from equipment.CraftingCost; its charm material builder uses craft recipes first and upgrade recipes otherwise. Existing catalogue forge/upgrade paths are preserved. Reward-only pieces receive no fabricated price. Nine charm costs match name and rarity but have missing or differing old-source materials; their cost is explicit and their catalogue materials are left unchanged. Ten catalogue records are absent from the pinned source.
